_note: Canny Alley channel art concepts (2026-10-26). run_concepts.py builds prompts as: style + band + scene + composition. The band block is shared word for word so the cast stays roughly the same across concepts.
band: The band Canny Alley, four young musicians in their early twenties, real people: (1) a tall skinny young man with long straight ginger-red hair and slightly yellow-tinted round glasses, faded light-blue jeans, lead vocals and electric guitar; (2) a short plump young man with black hair and a natural, well-groomed waxed moustache, a small belly showing under a too-short faded band-logo t-shirt, black leather jacket, keyboards, analog synthesizers and drum pads; (3) an average-looking fit young blonde woman with a small tattoo on her forearm, smiling with an open mouth so her metal dental braces are clearly visible, electronic drum kit and percussion pads, backing vocals; (4) an attractive young woman with long brown hair, a long flowing skirt and a loose oversized knitted sweater, no jacket, nose ring and lip piercing, dark smoky eye makeup, vocals, electric guitar and a small synthesizer.
banner_comp: Very wide composition for a channel banner: the band is small in the frame and stands close together, all four people within the middle half of the picture's width, their faces slightly below the exact vertical centre of the image, with generous empty space above (ceiling, neon tubes, haze) and below (concrete floor, cables, effect pedals), and empty dark foam wall on both sides.
avatar_comp: Square composition, subject centred, nothing important near the corners because the picture will be cropped to a circle.

banners.b01-garage-flash: Grainy amateur flash photograph of the band rehearsing in an abandoned garage storage room, walls covered with grey acoustic foam panels, violet and blue neon tubes glowing on the foam walls and inside the thick haze, smoke hanging in the air, dark ambient mood, harsh direct on-camera flash with hard shadows, 35mm point-and-shoot film grain. The band members sit on amplifiers, a drum stool and an old crate, camera at chest height.
banners.b02-couch-press-photo: Deadpan indie band press photo in a dim abandoned storage room: the four sit side by side on a worn brown leather couch against a wall of acoustic foam, instruments resting on their laps, staring into the lens with blank eerie expressions, Gorillaz-like mood but real people, violet neon strip behind them reflecting in drifting smoke, direct flash, film grain, slightly cold colours.
banners.b03-alley-neon-sign: Night-time flash photograph in a narrow back alley behind a row of garages, the band leaning against a rough brick wall under a buzzing neon sign that reads "CANNY ALLEY" in violet cursive letters, wet asphalt reflecting blue and violet light, steam and smoke drifting, instrument cases at their feet, grainy disposable camera look.
banners.b04-basement-gig: Tiny underground basement gig: the band plays on a low stage made of pallets in a former storage room lined with acoustic foam, silhouettes of a small crowd's heads in the dark foreground at the bottom edge, thick haze lit from behind by blue and violet neon, one harsh flash freezing the musicians, sweat, grain, dark ambient.
banners.b05-vhs-crt: Still frame from a 1990s VHS camcorder: the band poses in a cluttered garage in front of a wall of stacked old CRT televisions showing violet and blue static, acoustic foam on the side walls, smoke in the air, scan lines, chroma noise, a faint camcorder timestamp in the corner, eerie and nostalgic.
banners.b06-empty-warehouse: Cinematic, eerie wide shot of a vast empty abandoned warehouse at night, the band small and alone in the middle of the concrete floor standing in a ring of their gear, a single violet neon ring light hanging above them, blue light leaking through broken skylights, low fog on the floor, grainy high-ISO film still.
banners.b07-open-garage-door: Seen from outside at night across a cracked parking lot: an open roll-up garage door, inside it the band rehearsing in a foam-lined room glowing violet and blue, smoke rolling out of the door into the cold night air, a single street lamp, flash catching the gravel in the foreground, grainy amateur photo.
banners.b08-after-show: Candid after-rehearsal moment in a messy abandoned storage room: the four slump exhausted on amplifiers and equipment cases, one laughing, one checking a phone, cigarette smoke curling into violet and blue neon light, acoustic foam walls, tangled cables, empty bottles, red-eye from a cheap compact camera flash, heavy grain.
banners.b09-motion-ghosts: Long-exposure flash photograph with dragged shutter: the band frozen sharp by the flash but with ghostly motion trails and blurred light streaks of violet and blue neon around them, mid-performance in a smoky foam-lined garage, eerie dreamlike, grain, slightly tilted horizon.
banners.b10-spray-painted-door: Early-2000s Myspace-era band photo: the band crowded in front of a battered corrugated metal garage door with "CANNY ALLEY" spray-painted on it in drippy violet letters, violet and blue gel lights, smoke from a fog machine, harsh flash, slight red-eye, grain, low-fi.
banners.b11-synth-table: Band jamming around a long table covered in synthesizers, drum machines, sampler pads and patch cables, in an abandoned storage room with acoustic foam walls, everyone lit from below by small LEDs and from behind by violet and blue neon, haze, harsh flash from the front, documentary photograph, grain.
banners.b12-double-exposure: Analog film double exposure: the band standing in a smoky foam-lined garage blended with a night city skyline of blurred violet and blue neon signs, ghostly overlapping layers, light leaks, heavy grain, eerie indie album-art feel, real people.

avatars.a01-flash-selfie: Close-up flash selfie of all four band members squeezed together cheek to cheek, faces filling the middle of the frame, violet and blue neon and haze behind them in a foam-lined garage, playful but eerie, grainy phone-flash photo.
avatars.a02-neon-sign: A glowing neon sign that reads "CANNY ALLEY" in violet cursive letters mounted on a dark grey acoustic foam wall, blue neon outline underneath, smoke drifting through the light, no people, centred logo-like composition, grainy photograph.
avatars.a03-yellow-glasses: Moody still life close-up: a pair of slightly yellow-tinted round glasses lying on the keys of an analog synthesizer, violet and blue neon reflected in the lenses, haze, shallow depth of field, grain.
avatars.a04-fisheye-above: Fisheye lens photo from directly above: the four band members on a concrete floor surrounded by cables and pedals, all looking up into the camera, their heads close together in the centre, violet and blue neon light, flash, grain.
avatars.a05-doorway-silhouette: Four silhouettes of the band standing in a doorway, backlit by intense blue and violet neon, thick smoke around them, faces barely visible, eerie and mysterious, centred, grainy.
avatars.a06-frontman-portrait: Tight portrait of the singer: a tall skinny young man with long straight ginger-red hair and slightly yellow-tinted round glasses reflecting violet neon, singing into an old microphone, smoke, harsh flash, grain, real person.
avatars.a07-cassette: A cassette tape with a handwritten label reading "CANNY ALLEY" lying on grey acoustic foam, violet and blue neon light, haze, macro photograph, grain, centred.
avatars.a08-photo-booth: Photo-booth style picture split into a 2x2 grid of four square frames, one band member in each frame making a deadpan face, flash, violet and blue tint, grain, real people.
